svg.title: Backup and restore
svg.desc: Backup, verification, restore preview, confirmation, checkpoint, health validation, retention, and database recovery.

a.xlink:title: publishes validated command (NATS)
stored in (SQLite)
durable delivery (JetStream)
runs backup work (Python)
updates backup state (SQLite)
verified backup input (Manifest)
records sanitized lifecycle (SQLite/NATS)
updates restore state (SQLite)
creates checkpoint before apply (NATS)
provides recovery point (SQLite)
verified backup/restore (SQLite/filesystem)
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
Fleet, Apps, Security, Recovery, and Release APIs. Exposes domain-specific read and command endpoints while preserving backend-owned lifecycle execution.
Backup, restore, and checkpoint state. Stores backup manifests, recovery operations, current state, database backups/restores, and restore checkpoints.
SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
Backup and verification engine. Creates and verifies local encrypted backups through backend/worker-owned operations.
Restore preview and confirmed restore. Builds a non-destructive preview, requires explicit confirmation, creates a checkpoint, applies restore, and validates health.
Checkpoints and retention policy. Creates pre-change checkpoints and applies explicit bounded retention without silently deleting current state.

Explicit retirement and database recovery. Requires assessment and confirmation for device retirement and provides verified database backup/preview/restore without coupling command cleanup to device deletion.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
